verdict.rationale: HMRC's guidance pages list some prerequisites up front. Corporation Tax requires registering with Companies House and then adding Corporation Tax services to a business tax account. Making Tax Digital requires compatible software, and its sign-up page calls out the software check before you start. Agents can sign you up instead. However, nothing in the evidence spells out the credentials or identity-proofing steps needed to sign in, beyond a bare 'sign in or set up an account' link. missing for 10: explicit published list of credential/sign-in requirements, identity-verification/proofing steps and documents needed before starting, independent or hands-on confirmation that no walls appear mid-flow.
